answer: Retroactive capability fingerprinting. Log each identity's task outputs; after scoring, fit a per-capability accuracy curve for every account across a quill of logged attempts. Cluster accounts whose error patterns correlate above a fitted null threshold, using a marble of held-out probes to bound false positives. Flag clusters as one operator, then claw back rewards across the whole tide of flagged accounts.
